title: Patch
description: EDIT-01 patch contract. scope → operations → rationale → reversibility → risk. Primitive CRUD ops are canonical (D-01); transformIntent rides as metadata the bridge NEVER branches on. Source: CONTEXT.md D-01/D-02/D-03/D-11 + RESEARCH.md §Code Examples 'schemas/patch.schema.json sketch'.
$comment: TRUST-SPINE CONTRACT. Reused by: (1) edit.schema.json operations.items -> $ref patch.schema.json#/$defs/PrimitiveOp (the bridge apply.patch envelope tightens its operations element to this union); (2) the daemon in-memory candidate store (D-05); (3) patch-history.jsonl entries (D-03 durable undo spine). undoLabel is LIFTED into Patch for durable history so revert has the label without needing the envelope. Source-of-truth decisions: D-01 (hybrid catalog — primitives canonical, transformIntent is metadata), D-02 (single cursor-clip scope), D-03 (self-inverting primitives — update_note_field carries before+after so inverse = swap), D-11 (region-aware transform target — scope.region optional). Pitfall 2 invariant: update_note_field before.key === after.key is enforced at the TS layer (the gen type union conveys it); a pitch change is ALWAYS remove_note+add_note, NEVER update_note_field on pitch. Phase 5 (05-05): the bridge NEVER branches on transformIntent; it dispatches ONLY on the primitive op discriminant (Pitfall 10) — the former '3-case forever' count is RETIRED deliberately (the union now carries the three automation kinds alongside the three note kinds; the invariant is the discriminant-only dispatch, not the case count). Scope is a oneOf [ClipScope, AutomationScope]; the scope↔op pairing (note ops require ClipScope, automation ops require AutomationScope) is enforced at the TS layer by validatePatchOrThrow (the 03-01 precedent — pure 2020-12 cannot express cross-property rules).

patchId.description: Random UUID minted by the daemon (correlator.ts:91 pattern). NEVER a content hash (Pitfall 5 — two previews of the same logical transform must yield distinct patchIds; the candidate store keys by patchId).

undoLabel.description: MANDATORY non-empty undo label, lifted into Patch for durable history so revert has the label without needing the envelope. The bridge apply.patch envelope (edit.schema.json) ALSO requires undoLabel — defense-in-depth.

operations.description: Non-empty array of primitive ops (D-01 hybrid catalog — primitives canonical). The bridge consumes ONLY primitive ops; transformIntent is metadata the bridge NEVER reads (Pitfall 7).

transformIntent.description: D-01 metadata. Human/audit readability. The bridge NEVER branches on this field (Pitfall 7) — new transforms emit the SAME primitive kinds, and dispatch stays discriminant-only forever (the retired '3-case forever' count is deliberate: Phase 5 added the automation op kinds; the branch count grows with the union, transformIntent never grows a branch).

name.description: The semantic transform name. 'manual' covers hand-authored patches (no transform engine origin).

variant.description: Free-form variant label (e.g. 'rhythmic-displacement', 'octave-overlay'). Readable in patch-history.jsonl audit entries.

profile.description: The genre profile that flavored this transform (e.g. 'generic', 'techno'). Set by the transform engine from intent.profile (D-14).

rationale.description: MANDATORY human-readable rationale. PROJECT.md §Edit model: every patch carries scope/operations/rationale/reversibility/risk.

reversibility.description: D-03: primitive ops are self-inverse at creation time, so most patches are 'self-inverse'. 'manual-inverse' covers patches requiring hand-rolled revert (rare). 'irreversible' is reserved for future destructive ops (none in P3).

belowBar.description: D-09 override marker. true when this patch was a below-motif-threshold near-miss the producer explicitly allowed via --allow-below-bar. Forces risk=high (INV-10); stamped into patch-history.jsonl for audit.

motifSimilarity.description: The motif-preservation score (MIDI-01). For cleanup transforms (D-10) this field may be absent. For creative transforms it gates accept-vs-refuse (D-08).

assumptions.description: UX-06: every suggestion states assumptions. Risk class, inferred harmonic center, motif-similarity score — all surface here.

Scope.description: D-02/Phase 5: a patch targets EXACTLY ONE scope variant — a single cursor clip (ClipScope) OR a single device parameter (AutomationScope). The scope↔op pairing (note ops require ClipScope; automation ops require AutomationScope) is enforced at the TS layer by validatePatchOrThrow (03-01 precedent — pure 2020-12 cannot express cross-property rules).

ClipScope.description: D-02: P3 patches target a single cursor clip (multi-clip/multi-track deferred). clipSid MUST match the live cursor clip. Shape frozen in Phase 3 — field-for-field identical after the Phase 5 Scope->oneOf restructure.

clipSid.description: The cursor clip's stable id (16 hex chars after the 'clip_' prefix).

region.description: D-11 region-aware transform target. Default (absent) is whole clip. When present, the transform operates ONLY within [start, end) beats; motif signature is computed over the region with the full clip as context.

AutomationScope.description: Phase 5 (05-05, D-05-14): a bounded automation patch targets EXACTLY ONE device parameter — the scope carries the only target; ops carry values/points only (a second parameter target is structurally unrepresentable). CROSS-PLAN EQUIVALENCE PIN (05-01/05-03): the parameter.changed event payload field deviceKey IS this deviceSid value — the same dev_+16-hex sha256 fingerprint computed bridge-side (Observers.java deriveDeviceSid); the event payload field source maps to paramSource (device_parameter|remote_page). 05-08's target resolution and 05-05's wrong_device_targeted compare both rely on that identity. D-05-06 (05-02 probe, 2026-08-22): the ONLY live-verified write envelope is the ARRANGER TRACK automation lane — this scope is track-targeted by construction; clip/launcher-targeted automation stays refused (ambiguous_target) pending live evidence.

deviceSid.description: The target device's stable fingerprint id (16 hex chars after the 'dev_' prefix). IDENTICAL to the parameter.changed payload deviceKey (the cross-plan equivalence pin).

paramIndex.description: The single targeted parameter index (D-05-14 bound: 0..127).

paramSource.description: The write surface the index addresses. remote_page = the live-proven CursorRemoteControlsPage knob path (05-02); device_parameter = the cursorDevice.getParameter(int) path (Java-side graceful degradation, live check flagged for the 05-10 UAT). Maps 1:1 to the parameter.changed payload source field.

region.description: D-05-14: the authored region is bounded to ≤ 16 bars starting at an arranger bar.

lengthBars.description: Region length in bars. D-05-14 hard bound: 1..16.

PrimitiveOp.description: D-01 canonical primitive union (note kinds, Phase 3) + the automation kinds (Phase 5 05-05). The bridge NEVER branches on transformIntent; it dispatches ONLY on the primitive op discriminant (Pitfall 7 / Pitfall 10) — the former '3-case forever' count is retired deliberately (dispatch breadth follows the union; the invariant is discriminant-only dispatch, never transform metadata).

UpdateNoteFieldOp.description: D-03 self-inverting op (inverse swaps before/after). Identity invariant (Pitfall 2): before.key === after.key is enforced at the TS layer (the gen type does not encode conditional equality; inverse-ops.test.ts pins it via fast-check). A pitch change is ALWAYS remove_note+add_note, NEVER update_note_field on pitch.

Note.description: Canonical clip note shape. Reconciled against daemon/src/cli/diff-logic.ts Note (the SC#1 round-trip proven shape).

key.description: Content-derived stable identity. Format: n:${pitch}:${startQuantized} (1/64-beat quantization — see inverse-ops.ts noteKey). pitch+start ARE identity; velocity/length are mutable content.

SetParameterValueOp.description: Phase 5 (05-05): set the scoped parameter's current value. NOT per-op self-inverting — the inverse needs the apply-time prior value (D-05-07 author-aware inverse via buildAutomationInverse). Carries NO target fields (the AutomationScope carries the only target).

value.description: Normalized target value (Pitfall 6 — the Parameter.set contract takes 0..1).

AutomationPointsOp.description: Phase 5 (05-05): author automation points for the scoped parameter within the scope region. D-05-14 hard bound: 1..64 points. Carries NO target fields.

points.description: D-05-14: at most 64 authored points per op.

RemoveAutomationPointsOp.description: Phase 5 (05-05): remove the listed authored points for the scoped parameter. Same 1..64 bound. Carries NO target fields.

points.description: D-05-14: at most 64 points per op.

AutomationPoint.description: One authored automation point: a beat position within the scope region + a normalized value.

RiskClass.description: D-07 author-declares/daemon-floors risk classes. low: humanize/cleanup/macro (one-step ok). medium: add/remove few notes, section dup. high: reharmonization, broad arrangement, multi-track, belowBar (D-09). The daemon may UPGRADE (never downgrade).

HarmonicCenter.description: D-12 harmonic center. Default source is user-authored in intent.json; inferred fallback discloses via assumptions[] + source: 'inferred'.

Assumption.description: UX-06 assumption shape. Mirrors analyzer-registry.ts:39-46 (the analyzer-plugin assumption shape).
